question: Which keyboard shortcut opens File Explorer in Windows 11 OS to navigate and create files/folders?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Windows Key + E**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The shortcut **Windows Key + E** opens File Explorer in Windows 11, allowing users to navigate files and folders easily.
 
• File Explorer is a core file management tool in Windows operating systems, enabling users to view, organize, and manage data.
 
• This shortcut works universally across all modern versions of Windows, including Windows 10 and 11.
 
• Using **Windows Key + E** is a quick and efficient method to access File Explorer without navigating through the Start Menu or Desktop.
 
• This feature improves productivity for users by providing instant access to file storage locations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **File Explorer:**

 
 
• It is a graphical user interface for accessing and managing file systems in Windows operating systems.
 
• Introduced in Windows 95, it replaced the older "File Manager" used in earlier versions of Windows.
 
• File Explorer allows users to perform operations like creating, deleting, copying, renaming, and organizing files and folders.
 
 
 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts:**
 
 
• Keyboard shortcuts are combinations of keys that provide quick access to specific functions, saving time and enhancing productivity.
 
• Examples include **Ctrl + C** (Copy), **Ctrl + V** (Paste), and **Alt + Tab** (Switch between windows).
 
 
 
• **Windows Key:**
 
 
• The Windows key, located on most keyboards, is used to access the Start Menu or execute system-level shortcuts.
 
• Other useful shortcuts include **Windows Key + D** (Show Desktop) and **Windows Key + L** (Lock Screen).
 
 
 
• **Windows 11 Enhancements:**
 
 
• Windows 11 introduced a modernized File Explorer with a simplified interface and redesigned toolbar.
 
• It includes features like a compact ribbon, better integration with OneDrive, and improved context menus.
